Q: Thakns for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim file purposes. Can you
confirm you're comfortable continuing?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Please describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision happened.
A: I was driving on a multi-lane road in Sugar Land, Texas, heading toward the freeway. I was in the right lane and
needed to move left to get into the turn lane up ahead.
Q: Did you check your mirrors and signal before changing lanes?
A: I checked my mirror and I turned on my signal. I didn't see anyone right beside me when I looked, but the other car
must have been in my blind spot.
Q: What happened next?
A: As I started to drift over, I felt a jolt and heard scraping along the side of my car. The other vehicle had come up on
my left, and we sideswiped each other. Both cars pulled to the shoulder.
Q: Were you injured, and did you seek any treatment?
A: My neck and lower back were sore right away, and by the next morning the pain was worse. I went to an urgent
care clinic that same week, and they diagnosed me with a neck and back strain. I've been doing physical therapy
twice a week since then.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms today?
A: Yes, I still get stiffness when I turn my head and my lower back aches after sitting for a while. Some days are
better than others.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get the repairs and my medical bills taken care of.
Q: Understood. We'll be in touch with next steps. Thank you for your cooperation today.
A: Thank you.
</page>
